title: The Office Where Moments Are Shelved

features.name: the-filing-hand
features.desc-on-touch: You see a hand placing a moment onto a shelf, and it's unclear whether the moment ends or begins at the edge of the catalog.

features.name: office-desk
features.desc-on-touch: The desk holds files that are still warm from tonight's sorting. Each one is labeled with a time that might not have arrived yet.

features.name: checksum-shelf
features.desc-on-touch: The shelf keeps its own count. Every item filed raises a number that exists only here.

features.name: moment-becomes-data
features.desc-on-touch: This is what a moment looks like when the archive claims it: a row, a number, a place in sequence. But it still remembers being lived.

inscription: each moment shelved learns a number that was never assigned to it before

file.name: Moments_Shelved_Index_Running.tmp
file.note: A continuously updating list of moments being filed, but the timestamps keep arriving before they were recorded.

exits.label: back through the filing room's threshold
upward where stored moments begin to question their order
into an archive within the archive, where personal files sleep
